details: CVE-2025-68121 affects multiple packages. During session resumption in crypto/tls, if the underlying Config has its ClientCAs or RootCAs fields mutated between the initial handshake and the resumed handshake, the resumed handshake may succeed when it should have failed. See references for individual vulnerability details.
